name: browser-use
headline: analyze Claude Code usage effectively
short_description: Claude Analyst is a macOS menu bar app that monitors Claude Code usage in real-time. It tracks token consumption, costs, and usage patterns, helping users optimize their AI interactions without leaving their workflow.
author: onmyway133

sections.overview:
Claude Analyst is a native macOS menu bar application designed for developers and teams using Claude Code to monitor their AI usage in real-time. The app tracks token consumption, daily costs, and usage patterns across projects and sessions, helping users understand and optimize their Claude API spending without interrupting their workflow. It provides multiple views—including a dashboard with visual usage rings, detailed analytics with interactive charts, project-level breakdowns, and a chronological activity timeline—all updated live as you work. All usage data is stored locally on your machine with no external data transmission, ensuring your information stays private. Installation requires macOS 14.0 or later and the ccusage command-line tool, making it a lightweight addition to your development environment.
Monitor daily token consumption and costs for Claude Code sessions in real-time
Identify which projects consume the most tokens for cost allocation across teams
Analyze usage trends and peak activity times to optimize when you use Claude
Track session-level details and efficiency metrics to understand your Claude usage patterns
